# Synthetic reviewer checklist with six categories. The accessibility category is missing.

- `RV-correctness-1` samples and reference agree.
- `RV-clarity-1` the call is named in the task section.
- `RV-originality-1` the originality record is complete.
- `RV-difficulty-1` the difficulty matches the concept count.
- `RV-hints-1` rung 1 is a nudge only.
- `RV-ghost-1` at least two ghosts.
